# x402-mcp-commerce

> MCP server that gives Claude/GPT agents commerce tools: each tool call pays an upstream x402 endpoint and returns its artifact

x402-mcp-commerce is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-mcp-commerce/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
